AtariLegend daily database exports

The files below are exports of the AtariLegend database, minus the users table containing user accounts and passwords. The database is compatible with MariaDB 10.

In addition, all games images (screenshots, boxarts, etc.) are also exported in a ZIP archive.

The data can be used to build your own applications or generate reports.
